items.summary: My Jetson Orin Nano has 8 GB of memory and Gemma 4 26B-A4B needs 13.3 GiB at Q4. I patched llama.cpp to stream the routed experts off the SSD instead, with logits bit-for-bit identical to the stock path, and recorded the model decoding on device.
